in_sanskrit.name: Areeksha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wise Intuition
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Areeksha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Areeksha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ārī’ meaning ‘one who leads’ and ‘jñāna’ meaning ‘knowledge’. The name signifies a wise and intuitive leader.

in_hindi.name: Areeksha
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wise Intuition
in_hindi.long_meaning: Areeksha एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Areeksha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ārī’ meaning ‘one who leads’ and ‘jñāna’ meaning ‘knowledge’. The name signifies a wise and intuitive leader.

in_tamil.name: Areeksha
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Wise Intuition

in_telugu.long_meaning: Areeksha ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Areeksha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ārī’ meaning ‘one who leads’ and ‘jñāna’ meaning ‘knowledge’. The name signifies a wise and intuitive leader.

in_marathi.long_meaning: Areeksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Areeksha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ārī’ meaning ‘one who leads’ and ‘jñāna’ meaning ‘knowledge’. The name signifies a wise and intuitive leader.
